workshoptitle: HOL6021 - See Risk Across Every Database: Hands-On with Database Security Central

tutorials.title: Introduction: About This Hands-on Lab
tutorials.description: Understand Security Central, the workshop environment, and the risk-to-evidence story.

tutorials.title: Using noVNC Remote Desktop
tutorials.description: Enable fullscreen display, clipboard integration, and access to the workshop guide through noVNC Remote Desktop.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Access Security Central console
tutorials.description: Retrieve workshop credentials and URLs, reset console passwords, and verify Glassfish application access.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Assess and Discover the Risk
tutorials.description: Identify risks, discover sensitive objects and privileged users, remediate identified PUBLIC grants, and identify missing controls.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Audit, Monitor, and Alert on Privileged Activity
tutorials.description: Provision audit policies, create an alert with the Alert Assistant, and verify activity in reports and alerts.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Protect and Prevent Unauthorized Database Activity
tutorials.description: Configure and validate Database Firewall protection, with optional SQL Firewall and independent Database Vault tasks.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Review Compliance Evidence and Confirm Workshop Outcomes
tutorials.description: Optionally review GDPR reports, then use Security Advisor to review the controls and summarize target-specific outcomes.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Solutions to Common Problems and Directions for Receiving Live Help
